`AsyncMemory.reset()` hardcodes `delete_col()` unconditionally, bypassing the `VectorStoreFactory.reset()` optimisation that `Memory.reset()` already uses. The async counterpart skips this check entirely, so async users always get the slower `delete_col()` + full recreation path regardless of what the vector store supports.
